source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary:
A unit with 2 or more models must be in **coherency** when set up and whenever it ends a move. That means each of its models is:

- within 2" horizontally of 1 or more other models in the unit, and within 5" vertically of them
- no more than 9" away horizontally (5" vertically) from every other model in the unit

Measure per [Measuring Distances](vsdata:core-rule/measuring-distances). At each turn's End of Turn step, the controlling player removes models 1 at a time from any unit on the battlefield that is out of coherency until it is back in. Removed models are **destroyed** but trigger no rules for destroyed models.

detail.appliesTo: units with more than one model

conditions.of: at least one other model in the unit
every other model in the unit

frameModel.point: closest point of the model itself

outOfCoherency.checkedAt: End of Turn step of each turn
outOfCoherency.action: remove models one at a time
